text.text_excerpt: They have live jazz music for anyone who is interested. I enjoyed a nice bottle of IPA beer at this saloon. It was welcoming and definitely was a great time sitting and listening to live jazz. It is on bourbon street so there is always a heavy crowd. Usually this place attracts a lot of the older crowd rather than the young crowd, but if you love jazz music it is great to experience. You are free to dance and tip the band as you please. They have a menu that offers minimum good items like appetizers and other finger foods to pick at while you enjoy the music. Service is always fast and efficient the two times I went and I have no complaints about anything. They have to go cups sitting by ...

After trudging through Bourbon for a few hours and being inundated by smoke and shots the boyfriend and I were looking for a bit of an escape, we both love jazz music so when walking by we heard the music and decided to stop in. First of all, this place is a total dive (which again, we love) and it's crowded in with tables and staff right up to the stage. They do have a drink minimum, but many places in New Orleans do. We ended up staying for several hours through two different shows. Both bands were great, very different but really talented musicians.. I will definitely remember this place on future trips! Awesome jazz bar on Bourbon Street. My sister and I were bar hopping and she wanted to stop by Maison Bourbon because she had been here several years ago when she visited NOLA with her friend. My sister was annoying and wanted to stay long lol I usually like to dip in and dip out. The jazz band that was playing that night was really talented and their lead singer sounded exactly like Louis Armstrong, they were taking donations and since my sister put in money we were able to request them to sing "What A Wonderful World".
